description.en: A React 18 and TypeScript front end built with Vite 8. React 18 is no longer updated. Vite's error overlay keeps its colors and cannot be changed; Vite does not support --no-color.
description.zh-CN: 用 Vite 8 构建的 React 18 加 TypeScript 前端。React 18 已不再更新。 Vite 的报错框颜色去不掉，Vite 也不支持 --no-color。
